last.verdict: Solid beat and raised outlook, but weak U.S. demand and restaurant pressure kept shares lower.

reasons.label: Flat North America volume
reasons.text: U.S. and Canada volume was flat, down from 3% growth last quarter.

reasons.label: Restaurant pressure to persist
reasons.text: CFO says restaurant weakness continues into 2027; at-home drinking beats away-from-home.

reasons.label: Growth reliant on overseas
reasons.text: Global volume rose 5% and organic revenue 7%, driven by international markets.

story: Coca-Cola has beaten estimates for several quarters and kept nudging guidance up, with organic growth of 6% a year ago and 7% now. Shares jumped after July's raise. This time, flat North America volume and cautious consumer comments dominated.
